rules: Keep at least one clear content area before the first ad placement.
Use one popunder and one social bar per page; do not duplicate global scripts.
Use responsive 320x50 mobile and 728x90 desktop placements instead of forcing oversized banners onto small screens.
Do not use deceptive buttons, fake download controls, or ads that obstruct primary content.
Do not place advertising on Privacy, Terms, Disclaimer, Contact or About pages.
Keep third-party ad code isolated from core MovieBlog application code.
